card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 31 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 4.3 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RZ CMa: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 31.3 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,633 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RZ CMa: Per, Rad, Dist
